symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: Checkout failures trace to payment-service calling gateway-mock: during the incident window 6 /authorize calls returned 429 TooManyRequests (previous window 0), so payments were recorded FAILED and 6 orders went PAYMENT_FAILED, while 5 others authorized. gateway-mock shows no errors or restarts, and its latency stayed near 2 ms, so it is rejecting requests rather than slow. Order-service, inventory and postgres show no failures.
